items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I remember seeing him when I did the show -- this was in Paris... he was sitting in the front row, but I didn't get a chance to talk to him

ctx.x: Yes, he came to a concert. I remember seeing him when I did the show -- this was in Paris, we played

Freyel La Plaisail (phonetic) with the Jazz of the Swing Era and he was sitting in the front row, but I didn't get a chance to talk to him and I didn't feel that he cared too much for my playing anyway.
That's unfortunate. It seemed to me and I may be wrong, but it seemed to me that he was in New York at the time that Mezzrow formed that band and went into that New York spot, that integrated band.
